title: File Upload
description: A dropzone that says what it accepts, and a list that shows what it got.
a11y: The zone is a label for a real file input. The input is visually hidden but focusable, so Tab reaches it and Space opens the browser's picker (Enter depends on the browser); the zone shows the focus ring. Browsed and dropped files join the same list. Each remove button is named after its file, and focus moves to the next remove button (or back to the input). A status region announces added and removed file names. Drag highlighting belongs to each zone. The hint text steps up to --k-ink-2 on the tinted hover and drag background (7.16:1 light, 6.24:1 dark). A disabled input dims the zone and removes its hover tint. Screen-reader output and the native picker on each browser are not yet verified by hand.
